Every time you enter the game, a new random map will be generated.

[h3]Mysterious Events🍷[/h3]
There are many mysterious events in the game, triggering different plots or obtaining powerful cards

Build and customize your own deck, a perfect combination of strategy and cards, more cards and dream stones, making your deck more powerful.

The two of you had an ambiguous time, you loved her beauty and body, but hated the many suitors she attracted, which led to a gap between you, and eventually your relationship drifted apart due to personality twists and misunderstandings, and then you broke off your relationship and both left your hometown...By coincidence, you are reunited in a strange town, in a strange tavern, and she becomes one of the candidates for a contract girlfriend.

For some reason, she is always fond of purple color clothes, often wearing some simple suits or dresses, revealing a kind of mature female charm.
Her purple eyes were filled with suppressed interest in you, but for some reason she was deterred.

Gentleman Q: I heard that there is another candidate for contract girlfriend...? What's her name...?
Maomao A: You were saying just now that you couldn’t control yourself when you saw her fishnet stockings and big white legs...? (Maomao is speechless)
